title: Da Timeless
description:
I built a data platform for competitive MTG Arena Timeless,
covering data collection, validation, storage, analysis,
Discord integration and web presentation.

The platform brings together tournament and league results
with community-submitted Metagame Challenge runs.

Incoming records pass through validation and review before
publication. PostgreSQL stores published facts. Separate source
evidence allows records to be traced and checked.

A shared Python backend provides reporting and administrative
tools for the React website and Discord bot. Analysis covers
event results, deck performance and leaderboards.

Source code is private.

title: PokéML
description:
The idea of this project is simple: Can next generation Pokémon stats be 
predicted by training ML with current Pokédex data (1082 Pokémon + variants)?

This project works out the end-to end process. From data preparation, 
exploratory analysis, feature engineering, to model comparison and predictions.
It compares direct regression with a baseline-plus-correction
approach using CatBoost, LightGBM and XGBoost.

Results remain retrospective. All validation generations guide
model selection, so no untouched final test exists. Predictions
also depend on supplied evolution-stage and rarity assumptions.

title: Manim Ecosystem
description:
Three complementary libraries for scientific presentations,
animated companions and physics explanations:

- BeAnim provides presentation components and shared styling.
- Digital Presenter adds animated companions and scripted dialogue.
- String Cosmo provides objects and animations for string theory
  and braneworld cosmology.

Each library keeps its own repository, documentation and examples.
Components can be combined within the same Manim presentation.

components.title: BeAnim
components.description:
Create Beamer-like styles for Manim presentations.
Shared themes and reusable components give titles, equations,
tables and references a consistent appearance.

components.title: Digital Presenter
components.description:
Add animated creatures that help you present content in videos.
Control their pointing, expressions and dialogue through Python
or CSV-based scripts.

components.title: String Cosmo
components.description:
Manim objects and animations for string theory and braneworld
cosmology, including branes, bubbles, black holes, plots and tables.
